question: As of October 2020, Kristalina Georgieva is Managing Director of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**International Monetary Fund**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As of October 2020, **Kristalina Georgieva** is the Managing Director of the **International Monetary Fund (IMF)**.
 
• She assumed office on October 1, 2019, succeeding Christine Lagarde.
 
• The IMF is an international organization headquartered in Washington, D.C., working to foster global monetary cooperation and financial stability.
 
• The IMF provides policy advice, financial assistance, and technical assistance to its member countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kristalina Georgieva** is a Bulgarian economist and has previously served as the CEO of the World Bank.
 
• The IMF was established in 1944 at the Bretton Woods Conference and has 190 member countries.
 
• Its primary purpose is to ensure the stability of the international monetary system—the system of exchange rates and international payments that enables countries to transact with each other.
 
• The IMF's resources are provided by its member countries, primarily through their payment of quotas.
 
• The organization is governed by and accountable to its member countries through its Board of Governors and Executive Board.
